inputs.name: issue_json
inputs.description: Fetched issue graph snapshot JSON (must contain the epic; contains the selected child in epic mode).

inputs.name: task
inputs.description: Immutable user task text; required with epic_number for contract v2.

inputs.name: epic_number
inputs.description: Explicit epic/umbrella issue number; required with task for contract v2.

inputs.name: child_override
inputs.description: Explicit child issue number to override selection; verified against epic membership and readiness.
